item.title: Iran begins week of funeral ceremonies for slain Supreme Leader Khamenei
item.description: Top Iranian officials and foreign dignitaries pay respects to late leader killed in joint US-Israeli strike in February.

item.title: Pakistan bus crash kills 40
item.description: At least 40 people were killed and eight others injured after a passenger bus plunged into a ravine in Pakistan.

item.title: Hottest June on record in France as heatwave deaths rise to alarming levels
item.description: The average temperatures on June 24 and 25 this year were the highest ever recorded in the country.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis threaten Saudi Arabia after alleged airspace intrusion
item.description: Houthis say they confronted Saudi planes ⁠⁠allegedly trying to ⁠⁠stop Iranian civilian ​aircraft from landing in Sanaa.

item.title: Why is the UK mired in a maternity and neonatal deaths scandal?
item.description: An inquiry found that more than 500 mothers and babies either came to harm or died due to poor care.

item.title: Gaza sports community pledges to continue legacy of killed goalkeeper
item.description: Slain seeking cooking gas, Gaza goalkeeper Saleem al-Ashqar joins more than 1,000 Palestinian athletes killed in war.

item.title: France records 2,025 excess deaths at peak of heatwave as Europe braces for more extreme weather
item.description: Forecasters are warning of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days.

item.title: Iran begins public mourning for Ayatollah killed in February
item.description: Ali Khamenei's body will lie in state in Tehran's Grand Mosalla from Friday ahead of days-long funeral events.

item.title: Ebola treatments trial begins in DR Congo
item.description: According to WHO data, there have been 1,406 confirmed cases of the disease in DRC, with 301 suspected cases and 438 deaths.
